description: Remove the manual Begin Turn Plan gate and lazily ensure canonical Turn state when the player enters movement or selects/commits an action, while preserving explicit Reset Plan and End Turn behavior.

operations.search:
return `
No turn plan is active.

Begin a plan to track movement, actions, and Overcharge.

`;
operations.replace:
return `
Turn plan ready.

Select an action to begin tracking movement, actions, and Overcharge automatically.

`;
